findings.impact: After this PR, no automated CI check scans backend/src broadly for Anthropic/Claude API references or the enrich-project-overviews marker. The only surviving grep-based vendor guard, backend/tests/no-new-vendor.test.ts, has no anthropic/claude term at all and is hardcoded to a 6-file allowlist unrelated to backend/src/projects/*. Unlike a generic residual-risk claim, this repo has a live, active porting effort (issue #87, R11/#477) that is systematically re-implementing the same legacy 'backfill-project' six-step orchestrator into backend/src/worker/handlers/projects.ts: 5 of its 6 steps (discover, refresh_coins, refresh_wallets, sync_revenue, snapshot_daily, fetch_vaults, recompute_coverage) are already ported, with header comments explicitly enumerating all six legacy steps including the omitted enrich-project-overviews. A future contributor continuing this well-established 'port step N of backfill-project' pattern could plausibly port step 4 too, especially since 5 of 6 siblings already exist as 1:1 ports, and no CI signal would stop it. Mitigating factor found during review: backend/tests/api/projects-admin.test.ts asserts an exact string match on overview_short/overview_long after an admin write, which would catch AI enrichment that rewrites text on the existing admin write path — but it would NOT catch a new standalone enrichment pipeline/cron handler (the realistic reintroduction shape, mirroring how recompute_coverage was added as a new worker handler) that populates or overwrites overview text outside that single write path.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) add 'anthropic' and 'claude' to a repo-wide or backend/src/projects/*-scoped forbidden-term list (extending no-new-vendor.test.ts's pattern or a narrowly-scoped sibling test) so the same porting workflow that already ported 5 of 6 orchestrator steps cannot silently port the sixth, or (b) if manual review is the intentionally accepted replacement mechanism, add a CODEOWNERS entry for backend/src/projects/** and backend/src/worker/handlers/projects.ts (no CODEOWNERS file exists in this repo today) so a human review of exactly this surface is structurally required, not merely assumed.

docs/decisions.md explicitly records the trade-off (removal of grep enforcement, issue #93's admin-managed-overview-text intent unaffected) rather than silently dropping it — a disclosed decision, not a silent regression.
Repo-wide grep for anthropic|claude|enrich-project-overviews across backend/src at HEAD returns zero matches: the repo is genuinely clean today, not merely passing a check that no longer runs.

The stated false-positive rationale (PR #477's v0-roster-data.json containing incidental third-party project names/descriptions like 'KellyClaude'/'Claudeputer') is independently plausible: #477 is confirmed open (not yet merged) and adds backend/src/projects/seed/v0-roster-data.json, a 30k-line committed data file, which is exactly the kind of vendored third-party text a case-insensitive source grep cannot distinguish from a real SDK call.
backend/package.json has no @anthropic-ai/sdk (or equivalent) dependency today, and no bun.lock entry for one either — no live dependency-level exposure exists at this commit.

backend/tests/api/projects-admin.test.ts provides a genuine, executed-in-CI behavioral assertion (exact-string passthrough of admin-submitted overview text) that a naive AI-rewrite-on-write reintroduction would break — a partial mitigant this PR's diff does not remove.
